'''Paul Muhly''' (born September 7, 1944)<ref name=bios>{{citation|url=https://www.ams.org/notices/200008/bios00.pdf|title=Biographies of Candidates 2000|journal=Notices of the American Mathematical Society|pages=922–934|volume=47|issue=8|date=September 2000}}; see pp. 927–928</ref> is an American mathematician. In 2015 he was elected as a Fellow of the 
[[American Mathematical Society]] for his contributions to [[operator theory]] as well as 
mentoring and service to the community.<ref>{{citation|url=https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list|title=List of Fellows|publisher=American Mathematical Society|access-date=2024-05-19}}</ref>  He 
has supervised over 20 Ph.D. 
students.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|5417}}</ref>
